name: easy-stock-desktop
description: easy-stock AI A-share research desktop application
author: easy-stock contributors

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-hermes-runtime.mjs && node scripts/ensure-codex-runtime.mjs && node scripts/dev-electron.mjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:package && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs mac dir
scripts.release:mac: npm run prepare:package && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs mac release && node scripts/stage-builder-artifacts.mjs mac && node scripts/create-dmg.mjs
scripts.package:windows: npm run prepare:package && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs windows dir
scripts.release:windows: npm run prepare:package && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs windows release && node scripts/stage-builder-artifacts.mjs windows && node scripts/create-windows-archive.mjs
